# Secret Satoshis

> AI-native Bitcoin market intelligence. Original analysis and open data, built
> on more than a decade inside Bitcoin markets. Every published figure traces to
> a dated, checksummed input, and the pipelines that produce them are public.

Secret Satoshis publishes Bitcoin market analysis alongside the data and code
behind it. One price forecast is published each year with bear, base and bull
cases, then tracked in public against what actually happens.

## Where the work is published

- [Secret Satoshis](https://secretsatoshis.com/): the platform and the starting point.
- [Market Dashboard](https://dashboard.secretsatoshis.com/): current Bitcoin market data, valuation models, on-chain conditions and cycle context, updated daily.
- [Chart Library](https://charts.secretsatoshis.com/): 59 interactive charts covering price, on-chain activity, supply, mining and valuation. Each chart is a standalone page with its own definition.
- [Newsletter](https://newsletter.secretsatoshis.com/): written analysis, the annual outlook and the reports that score it.
- [Agent 21](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-BZXtVdU6M-agent-21): a custom GPT interface to the published research and live Bitcoin network data.

## Data and code

- [Chart catalog](https://charts.secretsatoshis.com/catalog.json): machine-readable index of every chart, with title, description, category and tags.
- [Chart sitemap](https://charts.secretsatoshis.com/sitemap.xml): every chart URL.
- [Report Library](https://github.com/SecretSatoshis/Bitcoin-Report-Library): the daily pipeline. Publishes the CSV release every other surface reads.
- [Published CSV release](https://secretsatoshis.github.io/Bitcoin-Report-Library/csv/report_ohlc_summary.csv): daily Bitcoin OHLC and week-to-date summary. Other series are published alongside it in the same directory.
- [Chart Library source](https://github.com/SecretSatoshis/Bitcoin-Chart-Library): chart definitions and the catalog generator.
- [Bitcoin Investment Strategy](https://github.com/SecretSatoshis/Bitcoin-Investment-Strategy): a savings-plan notebook, companion to the *Should I buy bitcoin?* framework.
- [GitHub organisation](https://github.com/SecretSatoshis): all public repositories.

## Reference

- [Start Here](https://newsletter.secretsatoshis.com/p/start-here): what the platform is and where to begin.

## Notes for agents

- Content and code are licensed GPL-3.0. Third-party datasets keep the terms of their upstream publishers.
- Data releases carry a manifest with retrieval time, coverage and a SHA-256 checksum per input.
- Nothing published here is investment advice.
- Created by Trey Brunson (https://treybrunson.com/).
